A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<div><section data-as=\"p\">First</section><section data-as=\"p\">Second</section></div>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("data_as_elements" = I(c("section"))), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
